lf-diagram.description: A Mermaid-syntax diagram rendered by Pele, with optional comment targets on its named boxes.
lf-diagram.x-instructions: Write Mermaid source inside the `<pre>`, HTML-escaping & before < and >. Give each diagram an `accTitle` naming its subject and an `accDescr` describing its relationships, for a reader who can't see it. Draw a chain of more than three steps top-down (`flowchart TD`), since a long horizontal chain runs past the page's edge. Give a node that needs its own tone a Mermaid class styled as `.pele-node.CLASS` in page CSS with theme tokens. Without `parts`, the whole diagram is one comment target; with `parts="all"`, each named box, such as a flowchart node or a sequence participant, is a target of its own. Edges and messages never are.
lf-diagram.x-example:
flowchart TD
  accTitle: Checkout from cart to receipt
  accDescr: The cart reaches a payment decision; a paid order produces a receipt.
  Cart([Cart]) --> Pay{Paid?}
  Pay --> Receipt[(Receipt)]
